summary: Iter 53 — Verified SWR client-side caching extension to Payments/Invoices/Locations. Backend: 8/9 tests pass (1 failure is business constraint plan_limit_reached for locations, not a regression). Frontend Playwright network trace confirms SWR cache works exactly as designed: (a) Betalingen v1 fetches /payments + /tenants + /payments?status=pending_approval, v2 fires ZERO requests within 1.7s window and renders 4 payment rows instantly (no skeleton). (b) Facturen v1 fetches /invoices + /tenants/credits (/tenants deduped from Betalingen cache!), v2 = 0 requests, 3 rows instant. (c) Locaties v1 fetches /locations, v2 = 0 requests, 2 rows instant. SWR wrapper fix from iteration 52 is intact in /app/frontend/src/lib/swr.js. All 3 pages correctly use useApiSWR + mutate() pattern with useAutoRefresh + admin-events preserved.

minor.issue: Demo company plan capped at 2 locations (plan_limit_reached). Not a bug — expected business constraint. Cannot easily add test-location for CRUD verification via this account.

critical_code_review_comments: Payments.jsx (~1230 lines) is above 700-line guideline — consider splitting into ./payments/PaymentRow.jsx, PaymentDetail.jsx, ApprovePaymentSheet.jsx, PaymentForm.jsx modules like Invoices was already refactored under ./invoices/. Would improve maintainability and mirror the Invoices pattern.

Payments.jsx has `useAutoRefresh(() => load(), { interval: 3000 })` calling load() which does Promise.all([refetchP(), refetchT(), refetchPend()]). Every 3s three SWR revalidations fire on Payments tab. This is intentional (pending payments need near-realtime) but /tenants revalidation every 3s is wasteful — tenants don't change that often. Recommend only revalidating /payments?status=pending_approval on the 3s tick.

Payments.jsx PaymentDetail useEffect fetches /invoices directly with `api.get('/invoices')` on mount instead of using the SWR cache. On a repeated open of the detail, this bypasses cache. Recommend `useApiSWR('/invoices')` (or accept invoices as prop from parent since the list is already cached).

Locations.jsx has auto-refresh at 45s but no SWR revalidateOnFocus disable — combined with the SWR default revalidateOnFocus:true, coming back to the tab will trigger an extra fetch (harmless, but worth noting).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — SWR cache verified 0 requests on 2nd visit for Payments/Invoices/Locations

seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo data (4 payments, 3 invoice-tenants, 2 locations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SWR cache extension verified end-to-end. Network trace: 1st tab visit → API calls; 2nd visit within 30s dedupingInterval → 0 requests, instant render. Selectors used: [data-testid='payments-page'|'invoices-page'|'locations-page'], row prefixes [data-testid^='payment-row-'|'mp-row-'|'mi-row-'|'loc-row-']. Deduping across tabs works: /tenants fetched once by Betalingen is served from cache to Facturen. Note: Payments tab has aggressive 3s useAutoRefresh — SWR mutate() calls are silent and don't affect the 'instant on tab return' UX. Backend location CRUD blocked by plan_limit_reached (2/2) — main agent may want to bump demo plan cap or clean stale locations to enable CRUD e2e tests.
rca of the issue: No new issues. Iteration 52's swr.js fix (explicit fetcher as 2nd arg) is preserved and now benefits Payments/Invoices/Locations too.
